identificationModule.briefTitle: Linperlisib in Combination With CHOP in Previously Untreated Peripheral T-Cell Lymphoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: Linperlisib in Combination With CHOP in Previously Untreated Peripheral T-Cell Lymphoma：a Single-Arm, Open Lable， Multicenter Clinical Trial（LINCH Study）

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This phase Ib/II, single arm, open label, multicenter study is conducted to evaluate the efficacy and safety of linperlisib in combination with CHOP for newly diagnosed PTCL patients, and explore the reasonable dosage of linperlisib when combined with CHOP regimen.

armGroups.label: Linperlisib in combination with CHOP
armGroups.description: Patients will receive six cycles of induction therapy of linperlisib in combination with CHOP regimen. All patients with CR and PR after induction therapy receive linperlisib maintenance therapy every 28 days until disease progression or other reasons lead to discontinuation, and the duration of linperlisib maintenance does not exceed 24 months.

primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: The first cycle of linperlisib in combination with R-CHOP regimen (21 days)

primaryOutcomes.measure: Complete remission rate (CR rate) based on the 2014 Lugano evaluation criteria (Phase II)

secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of complete remission to the study treatment until the date of the first documented progression or date of death from any cause, whichever came first, assessed up to 24 months

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence and severity of adverse events (AE) and Serious adverse event (SAE), as well as abnormal laboratory inspection indicators; Quality of Life (QOL).
secondaryOutcomes.description: To identify the incidence of AE, SAE and QOL.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Through study completion, an average of 2 years
